name: Tales in Distress 3
source:
Locke lived in a small village far into the mountains.
Every day was full of good times with longtime friends Alno and Remy.
Until the day that two rape orcs came.

Locke, Alno and Remy escaped the peril, but what can they do to save the village.

Love. Friendship. Resentment. Jealousy.
Mixed feelings and derailed intentions are every
person's burden to bear in growing up, but for these
heroes it's more than the natural road to adulthood.
Will their obscene torture and assault
warp them forever? Will they even survive?

An adventure sequel set in a fantasy world ruled by sword and magic. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE110578.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
洛克住在深山中的一个小村庄里。
每天都在和老朋友阿尔诺、雷米一起度过美好时光。
直到两只强暴兽人到来的那天。

洛克、阿尔诺和雷米逃脱了险境，但他们要怎样拯救村庄呢。

爱情。友情。怨恨。嫉妒。
混杂的感情和脱轨的意图是每个人
成长中都要背负的负担，但对这些
英雄来说，这不仅仅是通往成年的自然之路。
她们淫秽的折磨和侵犯
会永远扭曲她们吗？她们甚至能活下来吗？

设定在剑与魔法的奇幻世界的冒险续作。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE110578.html]DLSite English[/url]]
